title: Aurora Watch
text:
🌌 Aurora Watch — October 05, 2026

Near-Earth conditions are starting to line up: elevated Kp and faster solar wind. Sunny is keeping watch.

🌎 Kp: 4.00 (Elevated)
🧲 IMF Bz: -1.4 nT (Southward)
💨 Solar wind: 532 km/s (Elevated)
🚨 NOAA: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 5
☀️ Solar driver context: CH-HSS

Aurora ingredients detected. 👀🌎

Aurora visibility still depends on location, darkness, cloud cover, and how the magnetic field evolves from here. ✨

Image: NOAA SWPC — OVATION Aurora Forecast
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
